description: Returns a dentalunlock.com link for shopping a dental practice's office insurance: property and general liability (often a business owner's package), workers comp, cyber liability, employment practices, and employee theft (crime). Relevant when a practice owner, or a dentist buying or starting a practice, asks what office insurance they need or how to get quotes for any of these. With exactly one coverage, the link opens that policy's application directly; otherwise it opens a room-by-room walkthrough of the office that ends in a coverage checklist. For associates, explains that these policies are usually the owner's and links malpractice instead. Returns no prices, because carriers price these policies only from a full application. All inputs are optional. Does not submit anything.

coverage.description: Coverage the dentist asked about: bop (property and general liability), wc (workers comp), cyber, epli (employment practices), crime (employee theft). Omit if unsure.

role.description: owner, buying (buying or starting a practice), or associate.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

team_size.description: Employees besides the dentist: solo (none), 1_3, 4_9, or 10_plus. A number is also accepted.

name: start_practice_insurance_quote
title: Link to request dental practice insurance quotes
